entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support'.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely help you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti, order number is VF78901. I've been a customer for years, I just feel terrible about this.

Okay, thank you, Maria. I see your account now and I can see you're a VIP member with us. We really appreciate your loyalty. I see you ordered the ClubFit Jersey. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
Well, I was so excited for it to arrive, but... it's the wrong size. It's just too tight across my shoulders. I feel so silly for messing up the measurements.

Oh, please don't feel silly at all. Sizing can be tricky, and that's exactly why we have a flexible policy for our apparel. Since you received it just last week, you're well within our 90-day window. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it, and I really needed this money back if I couldn't wear it. It was a big purchase for me.

Of course. We want you to love your gear. I can process a full refund, or if you'd like, I can set up an exchange for the next size up. Since you're a VIP member, I'd be happy to add complimentary express shipping on the new jersey for you.
Wait, you'd do that? An exchange with faster shipping would be wonderful! I was so looking forward to wearing it this weekend.

It's my pleasure. Consider it done. I've just processed the exchange. You'll get an email shortly with a pre-paid return label for the original jersey that's too tight. As soon as you mail that back, we'll get the new size shipped out to you immediately.
Isaac, you've completely turned my day around. Thank you so much for being so understanding.
I'm very glad I could help, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thanks for being a loyal VeloFit customer, and have a great rest of your day.
